record.question: A attacks Z under such circumstances of grave provocation that his killing of Z would be only culpable homicide not amounting to murder. B, having ill-will towards Z, and intending to kill him and not having been subject to the provocation, assists A in killing Z. Which of the following judgment under Section 38 of IPC applies to A and B?
options: A is guilty of culpable homicide and B is guilty of murder
B is guilty of culpable homicide and A is guilty of murder
Both A and B are guilty of culpable homicide
Both A and B are guilty of murder
